technical.summary: Long-term trend structure is bullish (EMA/SMA 50/200, ADX, PSar, Supertrend) but price remains below intermediate moving averages with weak momentum (MACD negative, RSI mid-range, below cloud); three white soldiers pattern offers tactical support but lacks confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: AOS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 42 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling signal from non-senior member with small amounts; market fear (43 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro stress with VIX in crisis territory (418.4), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar headwind for industrials, and FOMC event just passed; earnings in 42 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term trend structure (EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish, ADX trending, PSar, Supertrend) with three white soldiers pattern provides technical scaffolding, and fear-zone VIX presents contrarian opportunity for tactical entry near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment in crisis (VIX 418.4, flat yield curve, rising dollar), zero fundamental conviction (no insider/institutional buying, earnings in 42 days), price trapped below all intermediate moving averages with weak momentum (MACD negative, RSI 44, below cloud), and no active strategy triggered—risk/reward heavily skewed to downside.
